summary: Reproduces exactly as filed on ground truth and on all 19 probeable releases (v1.5.2010..v1.9.2607); v1.4.1907 is invalid-probe (no SPIR-V codegen, confirmed by a flag-free control, since the primary capture was demoted only for an unknown flag). With the reporter reconstructed shift flags the used cbuffer c is decorated Binding 2 while the two unused cbuffers are fully DCE-eliminated; with no shift flags it is Binding 4, so the behaviour is not shift-specific. Source confirms decorateResourceBindings runs at SpirvEmitter.cpp:840, before spirv-opt at 972/988, and -O0 shows a=0 b=1 c=2 unchanged. DXIL mode compacts (c at cb0), as noted in the thread. Not a defect to fix: s-perron stated the design position in 2024 (default must not change; opt-in spirv-opt renumbering pass welcome), and DXC already ships -fspv-preserve-bindings which keeps unused resources rather than compacting them. Remaining actions are relabelling as an enhancement and two docs gaps in SPIR-V.rst: the behaviour itself, and -fspv-preserve-bindings, which is undocumented.
title: [SPIR-V] Descriptor bindings assigned before dead code elimination
